title: Pigeon Pals: I keep real pigeons in Brooklyn and built a loft/breeding/racing game with Claude Code (free browser beta)
author: PigeonPalsGame
selftext:
\*\*Pigeon Pals: a pigeon-loft game built with Claude Code, based on my real backyard loft in Brooklyn\*\*



I keep six real pigeons. I wanted a game that felt like keeping them: the odds every time you open the loft door, chicks that take after their parents, and the races. Claude Code wrote most of the code (TypeScript + Phaser), drew all the pixel art \*in code\* (no image generator), and helped write the dialogue. I wrote the briefs from real loft events, like three of my birds sleeping on top of the loft instead of inside it.



Things that worked: long written briefs per "pass", a test suite plus browser-check scripts it runs itself, and keeping a memory file of gotchas between sessions.



Free in the browser, open beta: [https://pigeon-pals-beta.pages.dev/beta/?src=reddit-claudeai](https://pigeon-pals-beta.pages.dev/beta/?src=reddit-claudeai)

28-second video (the real birds, then the game): [https://www.youtube.com/shorts/IVpaTTUzMm8](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/IVpaTTUzMm8)
